title: A performance refactor of AdminPermission.projects split one combined Q filter into chained .filter(teams__members=user).filter(teams__access=ADMIN_ACCESS) calls, so read-only team members get admin rights on any project that also belongs to some admin team.

findings.explanation: The change only manipulates Django ORM querysets using constant values and boolean flags; no raw SQL strings or concatenated user input are introduced.

The logic adjusts queryset filters based on admin/member flags but preserves the original intent: when both flags are true, no additional filter is needed, matching the previous OR‑combined Q filter. No missing ownership or permission checks are introduced.
